job.job_title: Full Stack Developer (React + Node + Python + FastAPI)
job.job_description:
Job Summary

Experience: 6-10 Years. (Immediate Joiners only).

We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Developer with strong hands-on expertise in React, Node.js, Python, and FastAPI. The ideal candidate should have experience in building scalable web applications, designing REST APIs, and working across front-end and back-end technologies in enterprise environments.

Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain scalable full-stack web applications.
Build responsive UI components using React.js.
Develop backend services and APIs using Node.js and Python.
Design and implement RESTful APIs using FastAPI.
Integrate front-end components with backend services.
Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Product, QA, DevOps).
Participate in code reviews and follow best coding practices.
Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade applications as needed.
Required Skills
6-10 years of overall development experience.
Strong hands-on experience in React.js.
Strong backend experience with Node.js.
Solid programming experience in Python.
Hands-on development experience with FastAPI.
Experience building REST APIs and microservices architecture.
Good understanding of database systems (SQL / NoSQL).
Version control experience (Git).
Strong problem-solving and communication skills.
